minecraft:written_book_content.title: Observation Sheet 3
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Researcher 12
pages: {"text":"No movement was recorded between the pillars. The instrument nevertheless measured a second presence."}
{"text":"The next report came from a site that does not appear on our survey."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. The cathedral record describes seven niches. A later hand says the same arrangement was measured beneath this observatory."}
